description.en: Before delivery, settled consequences must appear, prose must remain intelligible, and the Keeper must address the player in second person; numbers, length and literary taste are never graded. On a turn that establishes a place new to the investigator, the draft is judged against what establishing owes and steered once if it is thin.
description.zh-Hans: 交付前检查结算后果、正文可理解性与 KP 是否用第二人称面对玩家；不要求数字，不按篇幅或文学偏好打分。
